correctness.rationale: For uniform M∈GL_n(F_q), the diagonal homomorphism condition is M_ij!=0 => d_j=d_i². An invertible determinant permutation forces all d_i into the odd-order subgroup H. Equivariant block-permutation linear algebra gives the exact mean as a sum over squaring orbits and dimension threshold r=min ord_ell(2). An isolated r-cycle counts (q-1)^r G_(n-r) matrices per oriented support, with h=gcd(q-1,2^r-1) diagonals; pair intersections and all support s>r are exponentially lower-order via q^[(n-s)^2+s²/r]. Independently enumerated all 180 GL2(F4) matrices: 171 have trivial and 9 order-3 diagonal symmetry. This sample does not replace uniform asymptotic tail proof.
